lede: Twenty-four units that follow Luca or Lucia from the train platform in Roccamarina to a shop by the sea, a home and a family found again. Explanations in plain English, audio on every Italian word, and hundreds of self-correcting exercises.

units.subtitle: Welcome to Roccamarina
units.goal: Greet people, introduce yourself, say where you are from, spell your name and count to twenty.

units.title: La casa di Dora
units.subtitle: Dora's house
units.goal: Describe a home, say what there is and what you have, ask what and where.

units.title: Al Bar del Corso
units.subtitle: At the Bar del Corso
units.goal: Order food and drink, ask prices, pay, and say what you like.

units.title: La famiglia Ferrante
units.subtitle: The Ferrante family
units.goal: Talk about family, age and jobs, and describe people.

units.title: In giro per il paese
units.subtitle: Around town
units.goal: Ask for and give directions, tell the time and talk about opening hours.

units.title: Una settimana a Roccamarina
units.subtitle: A week in Roccamarina
units.goal: Describe your routine, say how often, talk about dates and the weather.

units.title: Al mercato del sabato
units.subtitle: At the Saturday market
units.goal: Buy food and clothes, talk about quantities, colours and sizes, say what you like.

units.title: All'ufficio anagrafe
units.subtitle: At the registry office
units.goal: Give personal details formally, fill in a form, say what you have done and make an appointment.

units.title: Com'è andata?
units.subtitle: How did it go?
units.goal: Narrate past events in order and tell a short anecdote.

units.title: Cerco un locale
units.subtitle: Looking for premises
units.goal: Describe and compare places, make phone calls and understand ads.

units.title: Com'era Roccamarina
units.subtitle: What Roccamarina was like
units.goal: Describe the past, habits and childhood, and contrast then and now.

units.title: Dal medico
units.subtitle: At the doctor's
units.goal: Describe symptoms, understand and give instructions, buy medicine.

units.title: Apriamo!
units.subtitle: Opening day
units.goal: Talk about plans and predictions, make promises, say what you will do if…

units.title: Clienti e vicini
units.subtitle: Customers and neighbours
units.goal: Handle service encounters, make polite requests and complaints, give advice.

units.title: Weekend a Napoli
units.subtitle: A weekend in Naples
units.goal: Book travel, order a full meal, describe a city and say how long things take.

units.title: Chiara parte
units.subtitle: Chiara leaves
units.goal: Express hopes, wishes and doubts, give advice, make a toast, write an informal letter.

units.title: Il primo inverno
units.subtitle: The first winter
units.goal: Narrate a complex story with background and prior events, understand a news article.

units.title: A tavola si discute
units.subtitle: Debates at the table
units.goal: Give, justify and defend opinions; express doubt, necessity and possibility.

units.title: Una videochiamata da Toronto
units.subtitle: A video call from Toronto
units.goal: Report what someone said, relay news, express nostalgia and doubt about the past.

units.title: Se avessi una casa mia
units.subtitle: If I had a home of my own
units.goal: Make hypotheses, express wishes and regrets, talk about buying a home.

units.title: In bici verso nord
units.subtitle: North by bike
units.goal: Describe experiences in detail, handle travel problems, express regret and what should have been.

units.title: Carte, contratti e burocrazia
units.subtitle: Paperwork, contracts and bureaucracy
units.goal: Understand official texts and contracts, write a formal email, describe processes impersonally.

units.title: Un matrimonio in Sicilia
units.subtitle: A wedding in Sicily
units.goal: Take part in a social event, give a toast, understand idioms, say what would have happened.

units.title: Un anno a Roccamarina
units.subtitle: A year in Roccamarina
units.goal: Summarise a year, reflect and compare, write an extended narrative, follow a natural-speed conversation.
